title: mimulus fruticosus
intro: Mimulus fruticosus, commonly known as Monkey Flower, is a flowering plant native to the western regions of North America. The health benefits of Mimulus fruticosus include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which make it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce stress and anxiety, and act as a natural remedy for digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Mimulus fruticosus include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
